As Intuitive Surgical (ISRG) Stock Price Rose, Oregon Public Employees Retirement Fund Raised Its Holding by $14.87 Million; Pineno Levin & Ford Asset Management Trimmed Qualcomm (QCOM) Stake as Share Price Declined 
April 20, 2018 - By Marie Mckinney 
Oregon Public Employees Retirement Fund increased its stake in Intuitive Surgical Inc (ISRG) by 418.77% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Oregon Public Employees Retirement Fund bought 40,851 shares as the company’s stock rose 11.58% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 50,606 shares of the health care company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $18.47M, up from 9,755 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Oregon Public Employees Retirement Fund who had been investing in Intuitive Surgical Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $51.60B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.37% or $6.33 during the last trading session, reaching $456.38. About 973,809 shares traded or 13.87% up from the average. Intuitive Surgical, Inc. (NASDAQ:ISRG) has risen 58.43% since April 20, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 46.88% the S&P500. 
Pineno Levin & Ford Asset Management Inc decreased its stake in Qualcomm Inc (QCOM) by 45.78% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC.
